about.heading: About me
about.name: Dariusz Kulig
about.role: Founder of kuldev. I design and write code.
paragraphs: I build software for businesses from idea to launch: I design the interface, write the code and make sure everything runs fast and without errors.
I enjoy projects where technology takes repetitive work off people the most. Before I build anything, I look at where your team loses the most time, and that is where I start.
You work with me directly, with no middlemen, so you always know who is responsible for your project.
